definitions.explanation: The state of being protected or secured, especially regarding rights or safety.
Ensuring that rights or benefits are maintained and protected.

examples.japanese: {社会|しゃかい}{保障|ほしょう}{制度|せいど}を{見直|みなお}す。
examples.english: To review the social security system.

examples.japanese: {憲法|けんぽう}で{人権|じんけん}が{保障|ほしょう}されている。
examples.english: Human rights are guaranteed by the constitution.

examples.japanese: {安全|あんぜん}{保障|ほしょう}{条約|じょうやく}を{結|むす}んだ。

notes:
Used for systemic or institutional protection of rights and safety.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{社会|しゃかい}{保障|ほしょう} (social security)
・{安全|あんぜん}{保障|ほしょう} (national security)
・{生活|せいかつ}{保障|ほしょう} (livelihood security)
・{人権|じんけん}の{保障|ほしょう} (guarantee of human rights)
・{保障|ほしょう}{制度|せいど} (security system)

HOMOPHONES (all ほしょう):
・{保証|ほしょう} - guarantee (for products, promises)
・{保障|ほしょう} - security, protection (for rights, systems)
・{補償|ほしょう} - compensation (for damages)

MEMORY TIP:
{保障|ほしょう} uses {障|しょう} (hinder/barrier) - protecting against threats
